description: Check a JS/TS or Python code snippet against the open GitHub issues filed against the exact package versions it runs on. Returns each issue the code touches (by the APIs it calls), with the evidence and the best workaround from the thread (untrusted third-party text).

language.description: Language of the code (default: py when the packages are PyPI, else js)

packages.description: The dependencies the code uses. Exact versions as your lockfile pins them: "next@16.4.0", "@tanstack/react-table@9.2.4", "pandas==2.3.1" (== means PyPI), or "pypi:requests@2.32.3". A bare name looks up the latest version.

name: landmine_check
title: Known bugs a code snippet touches
